title: Add and verify a custom domain
caption: Needs FEATURE_CUSTOM_DOMAINS=true, STOREFRONT_IPV4 set and a plan with limits.customDomains > 0.

steps.title: Add
steps.expect: `pending` row with records to create: `TXT _velexis.<host>`, `CNAME` to `<key>.ota.example.com` (or A/AAAA). `422 DOMAIN_INVALID` for a Velexis host or bad name; `409 DOMAIN_TAKEN`. Switch off or a plan with `customDomains = 0` (`early_access`): `403 FEATURE_DISABLED`.

steps.title: Check now
steps.expect: Job `domain.verify` on `platform-domains`; a second call within a minute `429`.

steps.title: Make primary
steps.expect: Only one primary per tenant; unverified `409 DOMAIN_NOT_VERIFIED`.

steps.title: TLS
steps.expect: `200` only for a verified custom domain of an active OTA with the switch on, or `<key>.<base>` of a provisioning/active/suspended OTA.
